**`src/numbering.js`** — invoice number generation
- `nextInvoiceNumber(existingNumbers, issueDate)` calculates the next free number
- Format: `INV-<year>-<counter>` (e.g., `INV-2026-0001`)
- Counter is 4 digits, zero-padded, starts at 0001, resets each year
- Handles unordered existing numbers by finding the max counter for the year
- Validates date is real and in `YYYY-MM-DD` format (returns `DATE_INVALID`)
- Prevents counter overflow (returns `TOO_MANY_INVOICES` if exceeds 9999)
- Ignores malformed numbers

**`issueInvoice(invoice, existingNumbers)`** in `src/invoices.js`
- Issues a draft invoice, assigning it the next free number
- Changes status from `'draft'` to `'issued'`
- Returns `NOT_DRAFT` if invoice isn't in draft status
- Preserves all invoice data (customerId, issueDate, lines, etc.)
- Never mutates the input invoice
- Propagates numbering errors (like `DATE_INVALID`, `TOO_MANY_INVOICES`)

- First invoice of a year and incrementing
- Multiple years with separate counters
- Unordered and large existing numbers
- Date validation (format and reality)
- Edge cases (9999 limit, malformed numbers, non-draft invoices)
- Data preservation and non-mutation
